name: Spirit AI
summary:
Spirit AI develops general-purpose intelligence for robots, focusing on models that connect perception, task understanding and physical interaction. Founded in January 2024, the company aims to give robots skills that transfer between tasks and environments, rather than requiring a separate fixed program for each situation.

Its Spirit model family, including Spirit v1.5, is evaluated on robot-manipulation benchmarks such as RoboChallenge. The company's work centers on translating learned AI capabilities into detailed actions in the real world. Its longer-term direction is to make adaptable robotic assistance available across everyday settings through a reusable intelligence layer.
